name: Clean UI
author: edkoch25
description: Configure which HUD elements Clean UI hides. When Hide Gameplay Hotbar is enabled, the hotbar is hidden during gameplay and automatically shown while inventory, storage, crafting, and processing-station interfaces are open. Changes apply after restarting the game. Mod Menu is optional and required only for menu toggle access.
